steps.thought: I will run the system power check to verify supply rails and overall electrical health.
I need to list the available tests first to understand the valid test names for this station.

tests.name: power_on_selftest
tests.description: Boot the unit and enumerate devices on I2C, UART and CAN.

tests.name: battery_rest_check
tests.description: Read pack and per-cell voltages at rest.

tests.name: esc_telemetry
tests.description: Read ESC telemetry: sync errors, packet loss, back-EMF detection.

tests.name: compass_static
tests.description: Compare compass heading to the fixture reference with motors off.

tests.name: harness_continuity
tests.description: Measure per-bus continuity resistance and CAN termination.

tests.name: camera_selftest
tests.description: Run camera built-in self test and measure frame rate and CSI errors.

tests.name: imu_static
tests.description: Log 1000 IMU samples on the static fixture: gyro bias, accel noise, dropouts.

tests.name: motor_spin_test
tests.description: Spin all motors at 50 percent throttle: current, RPM, RPM jitter, temp.

tests.name: compass_motor_interference
tests.description: Sweep throttle 0-75 percent and log compass heading deviation.

tests.name: battery_load_test
tests.description: Apply a 20 A load and measure sag, cell imbalance, internal resistance.

steps.thought: I will run power_on_selftest to enumerate all core devices and verify basic subsystem responses.
steps.observation: The power_on_selftest passed successfully with all expected I2C, UART, and CAN devices enumerated correctly and a boot time of 1849 ms. This rules out major power-on faults, missing CAN nodes, and completely dead communication buses, but further testing is required to check individual subsystems.

hypotheses.rationale: Initial power-on self-test passed with no detected errors across enumerated devices.
Subsystem-level tests have not yet been run to rule out subtle intermittent or performance faults.

steps.thought: I will run the battery_rest_check test to evaluate pack voltage and per-cell health at rest as part of checking every subsystem.
steps.observation: The battery_rest_check failed due to a cell imbalance of 0.076 V, which exceeds the maximum allowable 0.030 V threshold. This indicates a weak or unbalanced cell in the battery pack.

hypotheses.rationale: Cell imbalance of 0.076 V during rest check points directly to a weak cell in the pack.
Ruled out by the failing battery rest cell imbalance reading.

steps.thought: I will run the battery_load_test to check the battery pack internal resistance and performance under load.
steps.observation: The battery_load_test confirmed a loaded cell imbalance of 0.369 V and a high loaded imbalance, strongly pointing to a defective or weak cell in the battery pack.

hypotheses.rationale: Both the rest check and load test show significant cell imbalance, confirming a weak battery cell.
Ruled out by multiple failing battery cell imbalance tests.

steps.thought: The battery tests clearly show a weak cell. We will now propose replacing the battery pack as the rework action.
